messages:
alex: quick sync: we want to move SDKs from implicit route negotiation to an explicit handshake by default. goal is cleaner quota attribution and fewer silent fallbacks. thinking phased opt-in -> warn -> flip. risks?
priya: main consumer risk is CLI/short-lived processes that depend on background handshakes. need a sync API for flush or a tiny blocking handshake call for CLI workflows.
sam: also watch third-party gateways that strip headers. if SDKs assume header survives, we'll misattribute. we should emit telemetry when a client believes it sent handshake but router sees none. name: `handshake.sent_but_missing`.
glen: SDK implement notes: TS will expose a non-breaking helper `client.routing.enableExplicitHandshake()` which apps can call. we'll keep default implicit for two releases, then warn.
marie: PY gotcha: async context managers + lazy background tasks can lose the handshake on quick exit. propose `Client(init_handshake="eager")` as an API so callers can opt into eager handshake at instantiation. include example in quickstart.
alex: good. also propose an env var fallback `REDWOOD_HANDSHAKE_MODE` for infra-only customers who can't change code. precedence: explicit flag > env var > old implicit behavior. document clearly.
priya: telemetry plan: emit `handshake.status` events with fields: `tenant_id` (no PII), `sdk`, `sdk_version`, `handshake_mode`, `handshake_outcome`, `route_resolved`. sampling: 0.5% global, 10% during canary. include `handshake_latency_ms` to catch slow starts.
sre-bot: scheduled canary deploy: routing-router v4.1.0 will accept explicit handshake schema on 2024-07-11T03:00Z (job 11111).
deploy-bot: canary success  routing-router v4.1.0 on canary-a, 3% traffic.
sam: console needs an "Impact simulator" where admins can re-run historical requests to estimate delta if we flip default. UX should show per-tenant delta and let tenant owners opt-out before org flip.
glen: about SDK versions: TS bump will be minor but PY might need a patch release to add eager init. Go SDK will accept env var; add docs about precedence.
marie: migration lint idea: devex quickstart CI job can scan repos using old implicit pattern and auto-open PRs adding the new flag or a comment. we should ship a codemod for common frameworks.
alex: rollback/guardrails: if after flip any tenant shows >7% sustained mismatch between billed and predicted quota for 24h, auto-revert that tenant to implicit and page SRE. need automation.
priya: also add in-sdk opt-out for telemetry `client.telemetry.handshake=false` to respect strict PII policies. default is on, but needs to be clear docs.
sam: add a small E2E test in telemetry repo that replays canary traffic and verifies handshake events are ingested and route mappings match expected buckets.
marie: I'll draft the Console mock for the "Impact simulator" and copy for the migration email templates.
glen: action items: 1) sam: telemetry schema + PR, 2) marie: quickstart lint/codemod, 3) priya: write py eager-init patch, 4) glen: ts helper + go env var doc. I'll write the RFC and schedule cross-team sync.
alex: thanks all. will post RFC today and put follow-ups in the ticket. :thumbsup:
